about.label: About us
about.title: Pragmatic welding, done right.
about.body1: Kimuna Welding & Fabrication is based on Diika Road, Bweyale Town Council in Kiryandongo District. We're a down-to-earth team of welders, fabricators, fitters and civil workers that takes on steel structures, general fabrication, industrial gas supply, drilling support and hands-on training.
about.body2: We don't overcomplicate things. We listen, measure carefully, and build to last. Whether it's a gate, a warehouse frame or a full training cohort, we keep things straightforward and reliable.
about.mission: To deliver safe, durable and fairly priced metalwork and construction services while equipping young people with practical skills for real jobs.
about.vision: A trusted local partner known for honest work, dependable timelines and skilled people that help our communities grow.

services.label: 02 — Services
services.title: Eight services. One standard.
services.lead: From a 40-tonne warehouse frame to a single replacing door hinge — the same workshop, the same spec sheet.

steel.title: Steel Structure Construction
steel.desc: Design, fabrication and erection of portal frames, warehouse sheds, roofing structures and industrial platforms.

welding.title: General Welding & Fabrication
welding.desc: MIG, arc and gas welding for gates, doors, tanks, balconies, canopies and custom steel assemblies.

training.title: Technical Training
training.desc: Hands-on welding and fabrication courses for school leavers, artisans and site teams — theory, practice, certification.

gas.title: Gas Supply
gas.desc: Reliable supply and refilling of oxygen, acetylene and LPG cylinders with regulators, hoses and cutting sets.

safety.title: Health & Safety Training
safety.desc: Site-safety induction, PPE discipline, fire awareness and risk assessment training for companies and institutions.

civil.title: Civil Engineering Work
civil.desc: Drainage, culverts, foundations, slab works, water tanks and general building structures executed to plan.

drilling.title: Drilling Engineering
drilling.desc: Borehole drilling support, survey, pump installation and casing works for homes, schools and farms.

furniture.title: Furniture Dealings
furniture.desc: Sales, custom-made and fabricated metal and general furniture for offices, schools, hotels and homes.

why.label: 03 — Why choose us
why.title: Five reasons the quote comes back to us.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.desc: Welders, fitters and engineers with years on Ugandan sites — certified, supervised and continuously trained.

quality.title: Quality
quality.desc: Grade-checked steel, clean penetration welds and a finish inspected before anything leaves the yard.

safety.title: Safety
safety.desc: PPE, permits and toolbox talks on every job. No shortcut is worth an injury.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.desc: Agreed dates are kept. We communicate early if anything on site changes.

pricing.title: Affordable pricing
pricing.desc: Itemised, transparent quotes in UGX — no hidden margins, no surprise additions.

training.label: 05 — Training
training.title: Skills that leave with you.
training.lead: Two programmes run from our Bweyale workshop — practical, supervised and open to school leavers, artisans and company teams.
training.techDesc: Welding, fabrication, blueprint reading and workshop practice. Individuals and corporate intakes welcome.
training.safetyDesc: Worksite induction, PPE discipline, fire and first-aid awareness for teams operating on active sites.
